Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to correctly identify the oldest flavor in the Ben & Jerry's Flavor Graveyard. The user asked for the oldest flavor as of the end of 2022, which is "Dastardly Mash" (1979-1991). However, the WebSurfer agent initially focused on "Wavy Gravy" (1993-2001) and spent significant time scrolling and searching without correctly identifying "Dastardly Mash" as the oldest flavor. This led to a series of incorrect assumptions and delays in finding the correct headstone and the rhyme on the background headstone.
